entries.en: Could you speak more slowly?

entries.en: Could you call him?

entries.en: If I had known, I would have said.

entries.en: I wouldn't agree if I were you.

name.en: Level 6 — conditionals with бы on both sides

entries.en: If I had known you'd come, I would have stayed.

entries.en: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have been late.
